_comment: Profile B2 — Personal Mac (home-management context). PHYSICAL WORLD. Matches guardrail.py schema. Air-gapped from the coding context (separate agent identity, no coding credentials, no dev tooling). Tiered physical-action policy: reads auto (allow_default), lights/climate/media ask (T2 one-tap), LOCKS/ALARM/GARAGE/CAMERAS deny-unless-typed-confirm (T3). Point the home-management DA's PreToolUse hook here.

rules.reason: Lock change is T3 — never auto/forced; requires the principal's typed-yes per action.
Alarm state is T3 — typed-yes per action only.
Garage is T3 — typed-yes per action only.
Home context must NOT run coding/dev tooling (air-gap from coding).
Home context must not read coding secrets.

_notes: allow_default covers read-only telemetry (sensor/temperature/occupancy/lock-state QUERIES = T1 auto). Any WRITE matches a rule above. T3 deny rules are the never-autonomous tier: the matching tools require the principal's typed-yes confirmation at the channel layer (Telegram/iMessage tier-3); the guardrail refuses any auto/forced variant outright.
